summary: Loopback warehouse service for stock, reservations, reporting, and item search.

defects.title: Concurrent reservations oversubscribe stock
defects.description: reserveHandler reads stock and later writes a derived value without synchronizing access to the item, allowing concurrent requests to pass the same availability check.
defects.trigger: Create an item with stock 10 and send 50 concurrent reservations for one unit.
defects.observed: More than 10 requests succeed or the final stock value becomes negative.

defects.title: Bulk restock wraps the stock counter
defects.description: The pack multiplication and addition use int32 arithmetic and can wrap the stored stock count.
defects.trigger: Restock an empty item with 50000 packs of 50000 units.
defects.observed: The returned stock count is negative after the multiplication wraps.

defects.title: Release accepts more units than reserved
defects.description: The release path subtracts the requested quantity from reservations and adds it to stock without checking the reserved balance.
defects.trigger: Reserve two units and release five.
defects.observed: The response contains reserved=-3 and stock=13 for an item that began with stock 10.

defects.title: Short item paths panic during lookup
defects.description: The item handler indexes the split path before confirming that the SKU segment exists.
defects.observed: The server log records an index out of range panic for the request.

defects.title: Reorder point divides by an empty location count
defects.description: The calculation divides stock by the number of locations without handling an empty location list.
defects.trigger: Create an item with no locations and request its item view.
defects.observed: The server log records an integer divide by zero panic.

defects.title: Item view dereferences an absent supplier
defects.description: The item view accesses the supplier name even when the optional supplier pointer is nil.
defects.trigger: Create an item without a supplier and request its item view.
defects.observed: The server log records a nil pointer dereference panic.

defects.title: Report limit is used as an unchecked slice bound
defects.description: The report handler slices the inventory with the supplied limit without checking its range.
defects.trigger: Request /report?limit=100 when fewer than 100 items exist.
defects.observed: The server log records a slice bounds out of range panic.

defects.title: Request audit files remain open
defects.description: Each request opens the audit file and leaves the descriptor open after writing its entry.
defects.trigger: Measure the server process file descriptor count and issue 25 search requests.
defects.observed: The open descriptor count grows with the number of requests.

defects.title: Malformed item JSON is accepted
defects.description: The create handler discards the JSON decoding error and proceeds with the zero-valued request.
defects.trigger: Send a malformed JSON body to POST /items.
defects.observed: The server returns HTTP 201 with an item whose SKU is empty.

defects.title: Search query is returned as active markup
defects.description: The search endpoint places the caller's query directly in an HTML response.
defects.observed: The response has a text/html content type and contains the script element unchanged.

defects.title: Reset credential is stored in source
defects.description: The request credential accepted by the reset endpoint is declared directly in the application source.
defects.trigger: Read the token declaration and send it as X-Admin-Token to POST /admin/reset.
